hypothesis: A causal HAR-style volatility forecast can improve the current champion's net out-of-sample risk-adjusted performance solely by scaling down or abstaining during forecast high-risk states, without supplying trade direction.

implementationInterpretation.target: log of the sum of squared causally completed bar returns over the registered forward horizon
implementationInterpretation.features: intercept plus log realized-variance proxies over the trailing 1, 6, and 24 same-interval completed-bar blocks; unavailable blocks make the forecast absent
implementationInterpretation.fit: per-symbol expanding-window ridge regression with lambda fixed at 0.000001 after training-only standardization
implementationInterpretation.tradingUse: direction is copied unchanged from the frozen current champion; the candidate may only reduce absolute target exposure or abstain
implementationInterpretation.riskScale: min(1, training-only median forecast volatility / current forecast volatility), clipped to [0,1]; a missing, stale, invalid, or non-finite forecast yields scale 0

deviationsFromPapers: Completed bar squared returns proxy high-frequency realized variance.
The registered blocks are expressed in bars so 1h, 4h, and 8h horizons remain separate.
The model is evaluated as a risk gate around an existing direction, not as a standalone volatility trade.

universe.instruments: Binance USD-M perpetual futures; same-symbol spot bars may be explanatory only
universe.survivorshipRule: Every contract eligible at the dataset start remains in the panel through delisting; a later listing enters only after its first causally complete training minimum. Results are reported both fixed-panel and point-in-time top-liquidity where history permits.
universe.longShortRule: The risk scale is evaluated separately on champion long and short intervals. It cannot flip direction.

decisionTimestamp: close time of the last completed input bar
assumedExecutionTimestamp: next bar open after all candidate and champion inputs are available
featureAvailabilityRules: Each bar must be final and available by decision time.
Spot explanatory bars require the identical completed open-time grid and are never forward-filled.
Every fit, scaler, median, and risk threshold uses the current training prefix only.
Missing, stale, non-finite, revised-without-vintage, or schema-incompatible evidence produces abstention.

dataset.reason: Begins after the currently registered prospective funding campaign and creates genuinely new evidence. Dates cannot be moved earlier.

validation.design: nested expanding walk-forward within development; one untouched chronological final holdout
validation.purgeBars: maximum registered label horizon for the interval
validation.crossSymbolRule: A pooled summary is secondary; every symbol and BTC/ETH benchmark result is reported independently.
validation.crossExchangeRobustness: Repeat volatility forecast metrics on causally aligned Coinbase spot bars where instrument identity is exact; no exchange substitution in PnL.
validation.finalHoldoutPolicy: Open once only after code, features, costs, gates, and champion snapshot are frozen and committed. Any opening or interrupted opening consumes the holdout.

baselines: constant 0.25 gross exposure where economically applicable
current repository volatility-target and volatility-confidence gates

hyperparameterSearch.candidateGrid: none; one fixed HAR interpretation for each interval/horizon
hyperparameterSearch.adaptiveSuccessors: prohibited in this campaign; any successor is a new registration and increases lifetime count

transactionCostModel.baseline: Freeze the repository's causally calibrated maker/taker mix, spread, slippage, funding, precision, minimum-notional, missed-fill, and latency assumptions before development execution.
transactionCostModel.extremeCost: 25 basis points per unit turnover plus adverse funding and one missed entry for each ten attempted entries
transactionCostModel.marketImpact: report zero-impact and a square-root adverse-impact sensitivity; zero-impact cannot authorize promotion

forecastMetrics: stability by horizon symbol and regime
statisticalTests: paired block bootstrap versus ungated champion
CSCV PBO when any selection occurs
Hansen SPA where the complete aligned loss matrix permits
failureConditions: any holdout or active prospective-campaign overlap
risk scale above one or below zero
